# cycle_vpn (Data Source)

Reads the current VPN service configuration for a Cycle environment. The VPN is an environment singleton. `high_availability` is not returned by the API and is omitted here.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "cycle_vpn" "api" {
  environment_id = cycle_environment.api.id
}

output "vpn_url" {
  value = data.cycle_vpn.api.url
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `environment_id` (String) The ID of the environment whose VPN should be read.

### Read-Only

- `allow_internet` (Boolean) Whether VPN clients can reach the public internet through the service.
- `auto_update` (Boolean) Whether the VPN service container is set to auto-update.
- `custom_directives` (String) Custom OpenVPN directives configured on the service, if any.
- `cycle_accounts` (Boolean) Whether hub member accounts can authenticate to the VPN.
- `enable` (Boolean) Whether the VPN service is currently enabled.
- `id` (String) The environment ID this VPN belongs to.
- `url` (String) The connection URL for the VPN service.
- `vpn_accounts` (Boolean) Whether custom VPN user accounts can authenticate to the VPN.
- `webhook` (String) The webhook URL used for VPN authentication, if configured.
